shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, sunlit white sand fills the lower half

subject.character: wide flat stingray half-buried in white sand, mic on a stand at his mouth
subject.physicality: the disc ripples head to tail, eyes on top, never hurried; sand puffs up whenever he moves
subject.anti_action: lays scallop shells in a dead straight row at blinding speed, like counting chips
subject.consistency: same ray, same sand patch; shark and clownfish are the only other animals

cast.shark: shark in a tie circling above the whole take, pushing him to risk — never bites
cast.clownfish: tiny clownfish darting low, stealing shells, hiding under the ray

props.shells: row of pale scallop shells as coins: laid out, stolen, scattered, regathered, one left

environment: sunlit sand flat in shallow clear water, bright caustics, open water above
lighting: hard midday sun through clear water — white sand is the brightest surface, the shark's shadow sweeps it

audio.pacing: three lines, no gaps, at 0.6-1.8, 1.8-2.4, 2.4-3.2. Every final syllable fully voiced. Nothing spoken after 3.2
audio.lip_sync: the mouth on the underside moves on every syllable, the voice comes from the ray

timeline.a: the shark's shadow sweeps the sand, the ray bursts up out of it into frame. Silent
timeline.cam: low over the sand, rising with him

timeline.a: spoken calmly, last syllable in full. A wing sweeps a row of shells out of the sand while the shark banks overhead
timeline.cam: pushes in from the shells to his eyes, shark crossing behind

timeline.a: spoken calmly, no pause. He drops flat, sand puffing from under the whole disc
timeline.cam: drops with him to sand level

timeline.a: spoken calmly, straight after. The shark dives at him and pulls up short, wash blasting sand sideways
timeline.cam: whips up to the diving shark and back down

timeline.a: silent from here on. He lays the shells out in a dead straight row at blinding speed
timeline.cam: cranes into top-down over the row, turning

timeline.a: the clownfish darts in and snatches the end shell; the shark wheels round after the fish
timeline.cam: follows the fish, shark filling frame behind

timeline.a: the clownfish dives under the ray's wing; the shark brakes hard over him, sand exploding upward
timeline.cam: pushes low through the sand cloud

timeline.a: the ray does not move while the wash drags his whole row of shells sideways over the sand
timeline.cam: tracks the sliding shells through streaming sand

timeline.a: the shark leaves empty; the ray sweeps both wings and gathers every shell back under himself
timeline.cam: orbits low with the sweeping wings

timeline.a: the clownfish slips out and tries to drag one shell away; a wingtip pins it flat
timeline.cam: pushes in on the pinned shell

timeline.a: the ray settles over the shells, sand drifting back until only his eyes show. The shark's shadow passes once more
timeline.cam: cranes down to eye level as the shadow crosses

timeline.a: one shell slides out from under his wing to the clownfish. It takes it and bolts. The eyes blink once
timeline.cam: pushes in on the shell, then up to the eyes

negative_prompt: speech after 3.3 s, a clipped last syllable, the shark or fish speaking, a second ray, the shark biting anyone, pauses between lines, drawn-out delivery, any lettering, English text in frame, deep water, dark blue background, underwater city, reef, dim scene, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, snap zoom, whip pan, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra fins
